Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than expected, as the certifying body extended its standard review period beyond the original estimate. This has pushed our schedule back by two weeks.

Based on the revised certification timeline, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April. Our team has adjusted the internal schedule accordingly and will continue to monitor the certification process closely to keep this date firm.

Does this revised date of 14 April work with your own scheduling commitments on your end? Please let us know if there are any downstream deadlines we should be aware of so we can plan accordingly. We appreciate your patience and will keep you updated as we move toward delivery.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
